```{r}
# ============================================================
# Clinicopathological features across NMF clusters (pILC)
# Violin + box + points, Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon (BH)
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)    # stat_pvalue_manual()
  library(rstatix)   # wilcox_test(), kruskal_test()
})

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

# ---------------- 1. Paths and settings ----------------
out_dir      <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation"
clin_file    <- file.path(out_dir, "pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv")
cluster_file <- file.path(out_dir, "ClusterTable.csv")

# Column name in the file -> label shown on the plot
feature_map <- c(
  "tumor_cellularity (%)"                         = "Tumor cellularity",
  "pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)" = "Pleomorphic component cellularity",
  "TILs (%)"                                      = "TILs"
)
cluster_cols <- c("1" = "#1B9E77", "2" = "#D95F02", "3" = "#7570B3")  # Dark2

# ---------------- 2. Helper functions ----------------

# Make sample IDs comparable between files
make_key <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", trimws(x))

# Convert percentage text to numbers; "<5" (censored) becomes half the threshold (2.5)
parse_percent <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA
  is_lt <- grepl("^<", x) & !is.na(x)
  num   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^[<>]", "", gsub("%", "", x))))
  num[is_lt] <- num[is_lt] / 2
  bad <- !is.na(x) & is.na(num)
  if (any(bad)) warning("Could not convert: ", paste(unique(x[bad]), collapse = ", "))
  num
}

# ---------------- 3. Read and merge ----------------
clin <- read.csv(clin_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
stopifnot(all(names(feature_map) %in% colnames(clin)))   # exact column names must exist

dat <- clin %>%
  select(Sample, all_of(names(feature_map))) %>%
  mutate(Sample = make_key(Sample),
         across(-Sample, parse_percent))

clusters <- read.csv(cluster_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(Sample = make_key(sample),
            Cluster = factor(cluster, levels = 1:3))

message("Samples in clinical file: ", nrow(dat), " | in cluster table: ", nrow(clusters))
message("Not in cluster table: ", paste(setdiff(dat$Sample, clusters$Sample), collapse = ", "))
message("Not in clinical file: ", paste(setdiff(clusters$Sample, dat$Sample), collapse = ", "))

dat <- inner_join(dat, clusters, by = "Sample")
print(table(dat$Cluster))   # CHECK: expected 10 / 10 / 11

long <- dat %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(Sample, Cluster), names_to = "Feature_raw", values_to = "Value") %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(feature_map[Feature_raw], levels = unname(feature_map))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Value))   # NA removed per feature only

# ---------------- 4. Statistics ----------------
# Overall test: Kruskal-Wallis per feature
kw <- long %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  kruskal_test(Value ~ Cluster) %>%
  select(Feature, kruskal_n = n, kruskal_p = p)

# Pairwise Wilcoxon (normal approximation because of ties), BH within each feature
stats <- long %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  wilcox_test(Value ~ Cluster, p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE) %>%
  left_join(kw, by = "Feature") %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(group1, group2),
         y.position = c("1 2" = 106, "1 3" = 116, "2 3" = 126)[pair],  # bracket heights
         FDR_BH_all_9_tests = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

# Descriptive summary per feature and cluster
summary_tbl <- long %>%
  group_by(Feature, Cluster) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median = median(Value),
            Q1 = quantile(Value, 0.25), Q3 = quantile(Value, 0.75),
            min = min(Value), max = max(Value), .groups = "drop")

# Panel titles with the overall Kruskal-Wallis p-value
panel_labels <- setNames(
  paste0(kw$Feature, "\nKruskal-Wallis p = ", format.pval(kw$kruskal_p, digits = 2)),
  as.character(kw$Feature)
)

# ---------------- 5. Plot ----------------
p <- ggplot(long, aes(x = Cluster, y = Value, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white",
               colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = SEED),
             size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(stats, label = "p.adj.signif",
                     xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2", y.position = "y.position",
                     tip.length = 0.01, size = 5, hide.ns = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(Feature = panel_labels)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 132)) +
  labs(title = "Comparison of Clinical Features Across Clusters",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Value (in %)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

# ---------------- 6. Save ----------------
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_by_cluster_violin.png"), p,
       width = 14, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_by_cluster_violin.pdf"), p,
       width = 14, height = 6.5)

write.csv(stats %>% select(-pair, -y.position, -.y.),
          file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_by_cluster_stats.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(summary_tbl,
          file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_by_cluster_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(dat,
          file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_by_cluster_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Clinical features vs RNA clusters, adjusted for tumor cellularity
#  - Continuous: rank-based ANCOVA (feature_rank ~ cellularity + cluster)
#  - Binary    : Firth logistic regression (y ~ cellularity + cluster)
# Install once: install.packages(c("emmeans", "logistf", "ggpubr"))
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)    # stat_pvalue_manual()
  library(emmeans)   # adjusted pairwise contrasts
  library(logistf)   # Firth logistic regression
})

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

# ---------------- 1. Paths and settings ----------------
out_dir      <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Clinical_correlation"
clin_file    <- file.path(out_dir, "pILC_ClinicoPathological_details.csv")
cluster_file <- file.path(out_dir, "ClusterTable.csv")
cluster_cols <- c("1" = "#1B9E77", "2" = "#D95F02", "3" = "#7570B3")  # Dark2

# ---------------- 2. Helper functions ----------------

# Make sample IDs comparable between files
make_key <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", trimws(x))

# "<5" (censored) becomes half the threshold (2.5); NA stays NA
parse_percent <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA
  is_lt <- grepl("^<", x) & !is.na(x)
  num   <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^[<>]", "", gsub("%", "", x))))
  num[is_lt] <- num[is_lt] / 2
  num
}

signif_label <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA",
                             ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
                             ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
                             ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*", "ns"))))

# ---------------- 3. Read, clean, merge ----------------
clin <- read.csv(clin_file, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Print the categories actually present, so the recoding below can be verified
for (col in c("Grade/Differentiation-Desc", "BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc",
              "Tumor Marker #1 (ER)", "Tumor Marker #2 (PR)")) {
  message(col, ": ", paste(unique(trimws(clin[[col]])), collapse = " | "))
}

# HR/HER2 subtype columns: "Yes" marks the subtype of each sample
subtype_cols <- c("HR+ Her2-", "HR+ Her2+", "HR- Her2+", "HR- Her2-")
subtype_yes  <- sapply(subtype_cols, function(cn) trimws(clin[[cn]]) == "Yes")
subtype_yes[is.na(subtype_yes)] <- FALSE
has_subtype  <- rowSums(subtype_yes) > 0

dat <- data.frame(
  Sample                  = make_key(clin$Sample),
  Tumor_cellularity       = parse_percent(clin[["tumor_cellularity (%)"]]),
  Pleomorphic_cellularity = parse_percent(clin[["pleomorphic_invasive_compoent_cellularity (%)"]]),
  TILs                    = parse_percent(clin[["TILs (%)"]]),
  # Binary features (1 = positive / high); anything else becomes NA
  ER_positive   = ifelse(grepl("^Positive", trimws(clin[["Tumor Marker #1 (ER)"]])), 1,
                  ifelse(grepl("^Negative", trimws(clin[["Tumor Marker #1 (ER)"]])), 0, NA)),
  PR_positive   = ifelse(grepl("^Positive", trimws(clin[["Tumor Marker #2 (PR)"]])), 1,
                  ifelse(grepl("^Negative", trimws(clin[["Tumor Marker #2 (PR)"]])), 0, NA)),
  HER2_positive = ifelse(grepl("^Positive", trimws(clin[["BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc"]])), 1,
                  ifelse(grepl("^Negative", trimws(clin[["BREAST: Her-2/Neu-Desc"]])), 0, NA)),
  Grade_III     = ifelse(trimws(clin[["Grade/Differentiation-Desc"]]) == "Grade III", 1,
                  ifelse(trimws(clin[["Grade/Differentiation-Desc"]]) %in% c("Grade I", "Grade II"), 0, NA)),
  HRpos_HER2neg = ifelse(has_subtype, as.numeric(subtype_yes[, "HR+ Her2-"]), NA),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

clusters <- read.csv(cluster_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(Sample = make_key(sample), Cluster = factor(cluster, levels = 1:3))

message("Not in cluster table: ", paste(setdiff(dat$Sample, clusters$Sample), collapse = ", "))
message("Not in clinical file: ", paste(setdiff(clusters$Sample, dat$Sample), collapse = ", "))

dat <- inner_join(dat, clusters, by = "Sample") %>%
  mutate(cell_10 = Tumor_cellularity / 10)   # logistic effect expressed per 10% cellularity

message("Merged samples: ", nrow(dat))
print(table(dat$Cluster))                    # CHECK: expected 10 / 10 / 11
print(summary(dat$Tumor_cellularity))        # CHECK: no unexpected NA

# ---------------- 4. Continuous features: rank-based ANCOVA ----------------
cont_features <- c(Pleomorphic_cellularity = "Pleomorphic component cellularity",
                   TILs = "TILs")

run_continuous <- function(feat) {
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Cluster, cell = Tumor_cellularity, y = all_of(feat)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y), !is.na(cell))
  
  d$y_rank <- rank(d$y) / nrow(d) * 100                 # rank percentile (ties averaged)
  
  fit_full <- lm(y_rank ~ cell + Cluster, data = d)
  fit_red  <- lm(y_rank ~ cell,           data = d)
  
  p_cluster_adj <- anova(fit_red, fit_full)[["Pr(>F)"]][2]            # overall cluster effect
  p_cell        <- summary(fit_full)$coefficients["cell", "Pr(>|t|)"] # cellularity effect
  p_unadj       <- kruskal.test(y ~ Cluster, data = d)$p.value        # unadjusted comparison
  
  # Pairwise contrasts at the average cellularity; raw and BH-adjusted p-values
  em     <- emmeans(fit_full, ~ Cluster)
  pw_raw <- as.data.frame(pairs(em, adjust = "none"))
  pw_adj <- as.data.frame(pairs(em, adjust = "BH"))
  groups <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(as.character(pw_raw$contrast), " - ", fixed = TRUE))
  
  pw <- data.frame(Feature = feat,
                   group1 = gsub("[^0-9]", "", groups[, 1]),   # keep digits only: "(1)" -> "1"
                   group2 = gsub("[^0-9]", "", groups[, 2]),
                   estimate_rank_pct = pw_raw$estimate,
                   p_raw    = pw_raw$p.value,
                   p_adj_BH = pw_adj$p.value,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # Cellularity-adjusted rank percentile (cellularity effect removed, cluster effect kept)
  d$y_adj   <- d$y_rank - unname(coef(fit_full)["cell"]) * (d$cell - mean(d$cell))
  d$Feature <- feat
  
  list(
    overall = data.frame(Feature = feat, Type = "continuous",
                         Test = "Rank ANCOVA (F-test for cluster)", n = nrow(d),
                         Counts_or_note = "",
                         p_unadjusted = p_unadj,
                         p_adjusted_for_cellularity = p_cluster_adj,
                         p_cellularity_effect = p_cell),
    pairwise  = pw,
    plot_data = d[, c("Sample", "Cluster", "Feature", "y_adj")]
  )
}

cont_res <- lapply(names(cont_features), run_continuous)

# ---------------- 5. Binary features: Firth logistic regression ----------------
bin_features <- c(ER_positive = "ER positive", PR_positive = "PR positive",
                  HER2_positive = "HER2 positive", Grade_III = "Grade III (vs I/II)",
                  HRpos_HER2neg = "HR+/HER2- subtype")

run_binary <- function(feat) {
  d <- dat %>%
    dplyr::select(Sample, Cluster, cell_10, y = all_of(feat)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(y), !is.na(cell_10))
  
  counts <- paste0("C", levels(d$Cluster), ": ",
                   tapply(d$y, d$Cluster, sum), "/", tapply(d$y, d$Cluster, length),
                   collapse = "; ")
  p_unadj <- tryCatch(fisher.test(table(d$y, d$Cluster))$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  
  out <- tryCatch({
    f_full <- logistf(y ~ cell_10 + Cluster, data = d)
    f_red  <- logistf(y ~ cell_10,           data = d)
    
    # (a) Package's own penalized likelihood-ratio test between the nested models
    p_anova <- tryCatch(anova(f_full, f_red)$pval, error = function(e) NA_real_)
    
    # (b) Manual check: LR = 2 * (penalized loglik full - penalized loglik reduced), 2 df
    lr       <- 2 * (tail(f_full$loglik, 1) - tail(f_red$loglik, 1))
    p_manual <- pchisq(max(lr, 0), df = 2, lower.tail = FALSE)
    
    message(sprintf("  %s: p (anova) = %s | p (manual LR) = %s",
                    feat, signif(p_anova, 3), signif(p_manual, 3)))
    
    # Use the package test; fall back to the manual calculation if it is unavailable
    p_cluster <- if (is.numeric(p_anova) && length(p_anova) == 1 && !is.na(p_anova)) p_anova else p_manual
    if (is.numeric(p_anova) && !is.na(p_anova) && abs(p_anova - p_manual) > 0.05)
      warning("The two likelihood-ratio p-values differ for ", feat, ". Please inspect the model.")
    
    or_txt <- paste0(
      c("OR C2 vs C1: ", "OR C3 vs C1: "),
      sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)",
              exp(f_full$coefficients[c("Cluster2", "Cluster3")]),
              exp(f_full$ci.lower[c("Cluster2", "Cluster3")]),
              exp(f_full$ci.upper[c("Cluster2", "Cluster3")])),
      collapse = "; ")
    list(p = p_cluster, p_cell = unname(f_full$prob["cell_10"]), or = or_txt)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Firth model failed for ", feat, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    list(p = NA_real_, p_cell = NA_real_, or = "model failed")
  })
  
  data.frame(Feature = feat, Type = "binary",
             Test = "Firth logistic (penalized LR test for cluster)", n = nrow(d),
             Counts_or_note = paste0("events/n: ", counts, " | ", out$or),
             p_unadjusted = p_unadj,
             p_adjusted_for_cellularity = out$p,
             p_cellularity_effect = out$p_cell)
}

bin_res <- bind_rows(lapply(names(bin_features), run_binary))

# ---------------- 6. Tumor cellularity itself (unadjusted only) ----------------
cell_row <- data.frame(
  Feature = "Tumor cellularity", Type = "continuous", Test = "Kruskal-Wallis (not adjusted)",
  n = sum(!is.na(dat$Tumor_cellularity)), Counts_or_note = "",
  p_unadjusted = kruskal.test(Tumor_cellularity ~ Cluster, data = dat)$p.value,
  p_adjusted_for_cellularity = NA_real_, p_cellularity_effect = NA_real_)

# ---------------- 7. Combine tables, FDR, save ----------------
# FDR is computed over the same 7 features for both analyses (tumor cellularity excluded,
# because it cannot be adjusted for itself), so the two FDR columns are comparable.
results <- bind_rows(cell_row,
                     bind_rows(lapply(cont_res, `[[`, "overall")),
                     bin_res) %>%
  mutate(Feature = recode(Feature, !!!c(cont_features, bin_features)))

in_family <- results$Feature != "Tumor cellularity"
results$FDR_BH_adjusted_analysis   <- NA_real_
results$FDR_BH_unadjusted_analysis <- NA_real_
results$FDR_BH_adjusted_analysis[in_family]   <- p.adjust(results$p_adjusted_for_cellularity[in_family], method = "BH")
results$FDR_BH_unadjusted_analysis[in_family] <- p.adjust(results$p_unadjusted[in_family], method = "BH")

pairwise <- bind_rows(lapply(cont_res, `[[`, "pairwise")) %>%
  mutate(Feature = recode(Feature, !!!cont_features))

write.csv(results,  file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_adjusted_for_cellularity_stats.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(pairwise, file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_adjusted_for_cellularity_pairwise.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

print(results[, c("Feature", "n", "p_unadjusted", "p_adjusted_for_cellularity",
                  "FDR_BH_adjusted_analysis", "FDR_BH_unadjusted_analysis")])

# ---------------- 8. Figure: cellularity-adjusted rank percentile ----------------
plot_df <- bind_rows(lapply(cont_res, `[[`, "plot_data")) %>%
  mutate(Feature = factor(recode(Feature, !!!cont_features), levels = unname(cont_features)))

# Bracket positions and labels from the BH-adjusted emmeans contrasts
brk <- pairwise %>%
  mutate(Feature    = factor(Feature, levels = unname(cont_features)),
         pair       = paste(group1, group2),
         label      = signif_label(p_adj_BH),
         y.position = unname(c("1 2" = 112, "1 3" = 124, "2 3" = 136)[pair]))

print(as.data.frame(brk[, c("Feature", "group1", "group2", "p_adj_BH", "label", "y.position")]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(brk$y.position))   # stops with a clear message if a bracket position is missing

p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Cluster, y = y_adj, fill = Cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = TRUE, scale = "width", colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white",
               colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = SEED),
             size = 1.6, alpha = 0.7, colour = "black") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(brk, label = "label", xmin = "group1", xmax = "group2",
                     y.position = "y.position", tip.length = 0.01, size = 5,
                     hide.ns = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ Feature, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-10, 142)) +
  labs(title = "Clinical features across clusters, adjusted for tumor cellularity",
       x = "Cluster", y = "Cellularity-adjusted rank percentile") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 16),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85"),
        panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_adjusted_for_cellularity.png"), p,
       width = 10, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Clinical_features_adjusted_for_cellularity.pdf"), p,
       width = 10, height = 6.5)
```
